verify_ssl_disabled.title: TLS verification disabled for {name}
verify_ssl_disabled.description: TLS certificate verification for the BeSMART cloud is disabled for {name}. Credentials and identifiers are sent without verifying the server. Enable 'Verify TLS certificate' in the integration options; keep it disabled only if login fails because of a broken certificate chain.

tls_certificate_error.title: BeSMART cloud certificate could not be verified ({name})
tls_certificate_error.description: Home Assistant could not verify the TLS certificate of the BeSMART cloud for {name}, so it did not send your credentials. If the problem persists and you trust your network, you can disable 'Verify TLS certificate' in the integration options (not recommended).
